title: Japanese convenience store offering chance to have your shopping be effectively free for one day

details: Family Mart offering random reimbursements of up to 100,000 yen (US$630) . Japan’s convenience stores have become world-famous, not only for their convenient locations and operating hours, but for their amazingly wide variety of genuinely tasty snacks , drinks, and even full meals . Really, their only drawback is that they don’t always match the low prices you can find for similar items at supermarkets and drug stores. There’s a potential upcoming exception to that at convenience store chain Family Mart, though, where if luck is on your side everything you buy in your shopping run could be effectively free . On November 11, Family Mart customers who pay using the chain’s Fami Pay app can then play an in-app game, and if they win, they’ll be awarded Fami Pay credit equal to the entire cost of their purchases . The minimum purchase amount required to be eligible to pay is a paltry 111 yen (US$0.70), and the maximum possible prize is 100,000 yen. Technically, the 100,000-yen cap means that it’s possible you won’t be reimbursed for your entire purchase, but it’d be really, really hard to run up a bill greater than that in a single convenience store shopping trip. There’s no need to be concerned about the sharpness of your gamer skills either, as the “game” you play consists entirely of pressing the green start button twice, then being informed of whether you’ve won or not. Winners will immediately receive one yen worth of Fami Pay credit to confirm the win, and the rest of the credit will be added to your account in mid-December, with an expiration date of May 31. This delay is likely to prevent people from overspending and getting a bill they can’t afford to pay if they don’t win, since regardless of whether you win or not, you still need to be able to cover the cost of your bill at the time of purchase. Eligibility to play the in-app game starts at midnight on November 11 and runs until 11:59 p.m. the same day, though the in-app game can be played anytime between November 11 and 13. title: Los mejores animes del verano 2025 según los fans en Japón
summary: Silent Witch, Kaoru Hana y Sono Bisque Doll encabezan el ranking de animes más votados de verano 2025.
details: Anime Los mejores animes del verano 2025 según los fans en Japón Una encuesta japonesa determinó qué títulos conquistaron la temporada de verano 2025. Jin 1 de octubre de 2025 56 Comentarios ADS El portal japonés Anime!Anime! realizó una encuesta entre sus lectores para conocer cuál fue el anime más destacado de la temporada de verano 2025 . Con una oferta variada que incluyó secuelas esperadas, estrenos originales y adaptaciones de éxito, la competencia estuvo reñida. A continuación, te mostramos los resultados completos del ranking. 1. Silent Witch: La confesión de la bruja que no podía hablar Con un 10% de apoyo , el primer lugar fue para Silent Witch , adaptación de la novela ligera publicada por Kadokawa. La historia sigue a Monica Everett , creadora de la magia sin encantamientos, quien debe infiltrarse en una prestigiosa academia para proteger al segundo príncipe. Su carácter tímido y los constantes “quiero volver a mi cabaña en las montañas” contrastan con los momentos en los que revela todo su talento y valentía. Los lectores destacaron la evolución de Monica: “al inicio parecía incapaz de enfrentarse al mundo, pero capítulo tras capítulo mostró un crecimiento entrañable”. También fue aplaudida la construcción narrativa: “cada detalle de la trama tiene un propósito y la animación del opening transmite belleza y simbolismo”. Muchos seguidores pidieron una segunda temporada , señalando que incluso recurrieron a leer la obra original y sus spin-offs tras quedar enganchados con la serie. 2. Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku La comedia romántica publicada en Magazine Pocket alcanzó el segundo puesto con un 9% de apoyo. La trama narra la relación entre Rintaro Tsugumi , un chico de apariencia intimidante pero de corazón noble, y Kaoruko Wakuri , una estudiante de un colegio femenino de élite. La interacción entre ambos fue descrita como “refrescante y natural”, logrando conectar tanto con jóvenes como con adultos. Los comentarios de los lectores subrayaron que “la sonrisa de Kaoruko derribó las barreras emocionales de Rintaro de forma conmovedora”. Otros mencionaron que la obra destaca por un elenco secundario atractivo, como Usami , cuyo carisma sorprendió a muchos. En general, se percibió como un relato de juventud sincera y honesta , sin artificios, que deja una sensación positiva tras cada episodio. 3. Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru Season 2 En el tercer puesto, con un 8% de votos, se ubicó la segunda temporada de Sono Bisque Doll , el romance protagonizado por Gojo Wakana y Marin Kitagawa . Los fans resaltaron que, tras una espera de tres años, la secuela no decepcionó y mantuvo la esencia de la primera entrega. El entusiasmo de Marin por el cosplay volvió a brillar, y el compromiso de Gojo con la confección de trajes fue considerado una muestra de su autenticidad. “El amor por la creación y la complicidad entre los protagonistas se reflejó en cada capítulo”, mencionaron los encuestados. La inclusión de elementos originales en la adaptación también fue recibida con comentarios positivos: “el staff mostró su cariño por la historia y supo transmitirlo en pantalla”. El resto del ranking Además de los tres primeros puestos, otros títulos también lograron reconocimiento en la encuesta: 4º: Ruri no Houseki 5º: Dandadan Season 2 6º: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai 7º: Dr. STONE: Science Future (2º cour) 8º: Takopi no Genzai 9º: Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu 9º: Watashi ga Koibito ni Nareru Wake Nai Jan, Murimuri! La variedad del top demuestra que los fans valoraron tanto la fantasía como las historias románticas y de juventud . Desde propuestas ligeras hasta tramas más oscuras, la temporada de verano 2025 ofreció títulos capaces de satisfacer públicos diversos. ¿Qué anime del verano 2025 fue tu favorito y qué serie habrías colocado en el primer lugar del ranking? title: 10 frases de anime que impactaron más de lo que recordabas
summary: Estas frases del anime, desde Dragon Ball Z hasta JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, siguen siendo recordadas por su fuerza e impacto.
details: Anime 10 frases de anime que impactaron más de lo que recordabas Un repaso a diálogos de series populares que trascendieron y siguen siendo recordados. Jin 1 de octubre de 2025 65 Comentarios ADS El anime ha dejado incontables escenas memorables, pero algunas frases en particular lograron trascender más allá de la pantalla. Ya sea por la fuerza de los personajes, por el contexto en el que fueron dichas o por cómo resonaron en el doblaje latino, estos diálogos siguen siendo recordados como auténticos momentos icónicos. “No es así… ¡He venido a matarte!” – Dragon Ball Z La frase de Gohan en su enfrentamiento contra Majin Buu marcó un punto de no retorno en Dragon Ball Z. A diferencia de su padre, el joven Saiyajin siempre había mostrado un carácter más pacífico, por lo que escucharle lanzar esta amenaza con absoluta seguridad sorprendió a todos. Fue el instante que confirmó el despertar de su faceta más peligrosa: Gohan Definitivo . “¡No volveré a perder nunca más!” – One Piece Tras su derrota frente a Dracule Mihawk , Zoro hizo una promesa que definió su camino: nunca volvería a ser derrotado. El espadachín de los Sombrero de Paja lloró frente a Luffy y reafirmó su compromiso de convertirse en el mejor del mundo. Esta frase, inmortalizada en el doblaje latino, sigue siendo una de las más recordadas de One Piece . “No voy a morir, voy a ver si realmente estoy vivo.” – Cowboy Bebop En el episodio final de Cowboy Bebop , Spike Spiegel dejó una de las frases más filosóficas del anime. Al despedirse de Faye , el cazarrecompensas explicó que su enfrentamiento contra Vicious no era una búsqueda de la muerte, sino una forma de confirmar que todavía tenía razones para vivir. Este diálogo encapsula la melancolía y crudeza de la serie. “Hay un mundo entero allá afuera, más allá de nosotros y de nuestros sueños.” – Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Edward Elric pronunció esta frase como parte de una de sus mayores revelaciones. Reconoció que su búsqueda personal por recuperar lo perdido no debía anteponerse a los demás. Fue un momento de madurez y crecimiento que marcó la diferencia en Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood , convirtiéndose en una de las citas más recordadas del doblaje latino. “¡Ayudar sin que te lo pidan, eso es ser un verdadero héroe!” – Boku no Hero Academia Durante su enfrentamiento con Stain , Deku corrigió a Ida con esta frase que resume el ideal de un héroe. En un contexto en el que su vida estaba en peligro, sus palabras resaltaron la esencia del sacrificio y la empatía, consolidando el camino de Izuku como un auténtico símbolo de justicia. “He comprendido que las circunstancias de nuestro nacimiento no importan.” – Pokémon: La película En Pokémon: La primera película , Mewtwo reflexionó sobre su propia existencia con esta frase inolvidable. Creado como un arma, entendió que lo que define a alguien no es su origen, sino lo que decide hacer con su vida. El doblaje latino transmitió a la perfección la fuerza de esta conclusión filosófica. “Si no puedes distinguir entre demonios buenos y malos, no mereces ser un Pilar.” – Kimetsu no Yaiba Tanjiro Kamado lanzó estas duras palabras al Pilar del Viento, Sanemi , tras ver cómo atacaba cruelmente a Nezuko. La frase reflejó la empatía inquebrantable del protagonista, pero también su firmeza al enfrentarse a figuras de autoridad en defensa de lo justo. “Tener más sufrimientos no te da la razón.” – Jujutsu Kaisen Durante el enfrentamiento contra Mechamaru , Panda pronunció esta reflexión contundente. Reconoció el dolor de su rival, pero dejó en claro que la desgracia personal no justifica acciones que dañan a los demás. Un recordatorio fuerte de que el sufrimiento no es una excusa para la injusticia. “No pierdas el tiempo intentando ser el bueno.” – Bleach En medio de la batalla contra Coyote Starrk , el Capitán Shunsui Kyoraku pronunció esta frase que refleja la crudeza de la guerra. En el campo de batalla no hay buenos ni malos, solo ideologías enfrentadas. Este diálogo es recordado por su franqueza y la madurez que transmite en Bleach . “¿Acaso crees que yo, Rohan Kishibe, dibujo manga por dinero y fama?!” – JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Uno de los personajes más excéntricos de JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure dejó clara su postura con una frase que va más allá del propio anime. Rohan Kishibe declaró que no hacía manga por ambición, sino por pasión al arte. En el doblaje latino, esta línea se consolidó como un auténtico manifiesto de vocación artística. Estas frases no solo definieron a los personajes en sus respectivos momentos, sino que también se convirtieron en auténticos lemas para los fans. Son diálogos que han permanecido en la memoria colectiva gracias a su fuerza, y que siguen demostrando el poder narrativo del anime. ¿Cuál de estas frases recuerdas con más fuerza y cuál agregarías a esta lista? title: A Tale of the Secret Saint confirma estreno de anime en abril de 2026
summary: El anime A Tale of the Secret Saint reveló nuevo elenco y fecha de estreno en abril de 2026.
details: Anime A Tale of the Secret Saint confirma estreno de anime en abril de 2026 El anime de Felix Film suma voces destacadas y confirma estreno en abril de 2026. Jin 1 de octubre de 2025 13 Comentarios ADS El sitio oficial de la adaptación al anime de las novelas ligeras A Tale of the Secret Saint , escritas por Touya e ilustradas por chibi , confirmó nuevos miembros de elenco y anunció que la serie se estrenará en abril de 2026 . La producción está a cargo del estudio Felix Film . Entre las incorporaciones se encuentran Tasuku Hatanaka como Desmond Ronan, Daiki Hamano como Zachary Townsend y Tomokazu Sugita como Quintin Agata. El reparto previamente revelado incluye a Shion Wakayama como Fia Ruud, Shinnosuke Tokudome como Zavilia, Yuichiro Umehara como Saviz Nav y Nobunaga Shimazaki como Cyril Sutherland. Equipo de producción La dirección está a cargo de Tomoe Makino , con Naoki Murata como asistente de dirección. Deko Akao supervisa los guiones, mientras que Satomi Kurita diseña a los personajes. La música es compuesta por Kenichiro Suehiro y la dirección de sonido recae en Ryosuke Naya . Origen y trayectoria de la obra La historia debutó en enero de 2019 en la plataforma Shosetsuka ni Naro . Posteriormente, Earth Star Entertainment comenzó su publicación impresa en junio de 2019 . El manga, a cargo de Mahito Aobe , inició en noviembre de 2019 en la revista Comic Earth Star . La franquicia alcanzó más de 3.5 millones de copias en circulación . Además, las novelas ocuparon el segundo lugar en las categorías de Tankobon y Novela en la guía Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! tanto en la edición 2024 como en la edición 2025. ¿Qué expectativas tienes sobre la llegada al anime de A Tale of the Secret Saint ? title: Girls Band Cry lanza nuevo tráiler para su segunda película
summary: Girls Band Cry Movie Part 2, titulada Naa, Mirai, estrenará en cines de Japón el 14 de noviembre.
details: Anime Girls Band Cry lanza nuevo tráiler para su segunda película La segunda parte de la película, titulada Naa, Mirai, se estrenará el 14 de noviembre. Ryo 2 de octubre de 2025 23 Comentarios ADS Se lanzó un nuevo tráiler de la segunda parte de la película Girls Band Cry , titulada Naa, Mirai (Hey, Future), que se estrenará en cines de Japón el 14 de noviembre . La primera parte, Seishun Kyosokyoku (Youth Frenzy Song), tiene previsto su estreno para el 3 de octubre de 2025 . Reparto principal El elenco de voces está conformado por Rina como Nina Iseri, Yuuri como Momoka Kawaragi, Mirei como Subaru Awa, Natsu como Tomo Ebizuka y Shuri como Rupa. Detalles de la producción El anime original fue producido por Toei Animation con un total de 13 episodios transmitidos en Japón entre abril y junio de 2024 . La dirección estuvo a cargo de Kazuo Sakai , mientras que Jukki Hanada escribió la composición de la serie. El diseño de personajes fue realizado por Nari Teshima y la música por Kenji Tamai . Un proyecto en expansión Además de la película en dos partes, la franquicia Girls Band Cry recibió recientemente un proyecto cinematográfico independiente, reforzando su presencia en la industria del anime. ¿Qué expectativas tienes sobre la segunda parte de Girls Band Cry en la pantalla grande? title: My Hero Academia is opening a cafe that sells All Might margherita pizza
summary: My Hero Academia is launching a limited-time cafe in Japan that serves food and drinks inspired by the anime’s most popular superheroes.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment Food My Hero Academia is opening a cafe that sells All Might margherita pizza by James Busby Published: Sep 29, 2026, 09:58 Save for later Save for later Shueisha Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News My Hero Academia is launching a limited-time cafe in Japan that serves food and drinks inspired by the anime’s most popular superheroes, and there’s even an All Might Magahrita pizza up for grabs. Have you ever looked at a cheesy pizza and felt it needed All Might’s signature smiling face plastered over it? No, me neither, but that doesn’t mean MHA enjoyers don’t deserve to munch on the mighty man’s face. Four new pop-up cafes across Japan will allow you to do just that. LEGO announced the result of its ‘It’s Time to Duel!’ Ideas challenge after allowing fans to vote between five finalists. The winning model, titled The Heart of the Cards: Exodia, was created by LEGO Ideas user Step_on_a_Brick and depicts Yami Yugi summoning Exodia the Forbidden One. Article continues after ad The build shows the legendary monster emerging from enlarged Yu-Gi-Oh cards, creating an effect where Exodia appears to transform from a 2D image into a massive brick-built figure. The LEGO design similarly puts the monster front and center alongside a brick-built version of Yugi. LEGO Exodia defeats four other Yu-Gi-Oh finalists LEGO first announced its Yu-Gi-Oh contest in February 2026 , inviting fans to submit builds inspired by the Duelist Kingdom and Battle City arcs of the original anime. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad Entries were required to contain between 400 and 2,000 pieces. LEGO ultimately narrowed 264 submissions down to five finalists before handing the decision over to a public vote. title: Higurashi mahjong remaster turns matches into life-or-death fights against killer anime girls
summary: Higurashi is getting a mahjong game where players must take part in life-and-death battles against the series’ killer anime girls.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Gaming Higurashi mahjong remaster turns matches into life-or-death fights against killer anime girls by James Busby Published: Sep 15, 2026, 12:43 Save for later Save for later CITY CONNECTION Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News Higurashi is getting a mahjong game where players must take part in life-and-death battles against the series’ killer anime girls, where cheating, unfair tactics, and death await. Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster is a fresh take on a classic Japanese arcade game from 2009 and is built around two-player Japanese Riichi Mahjong. However, in true Higurashi fashion, the tile-based strategy games aren’t exactly your typical chill Sunday afternoon sessions. Instead, players must do whatever it takes to survive against their killer classmate companions to avoid a brutal demise, unlock new artwork, and get the game’s true ending. Article continues after ad Higurashi mahjong is back According to the Steam page , the Higurashi mahjong remaster features three game modes and an original scenario supervised by original creator Ryukishi07. As for said modes, there’s Oyashiro Mode, which pits you against the likes of Mion and Rena in an intense series of high-stakes mahjong battles. Just like the after-school games Keiichi plays in the original visual novel, players can cheat and use unfair methods to get an edge over their foes. You’ll need to use everything you can to avoid a grizzly death, especially when trying to get to the game’s true ending (you know, the less stabby version). Article continues after ad Article continues after ad For those looking for a more chill session without the fear of being brutally murdered, there’s the Club Mode. While you’ll still be able to cheat your way to victory to avoid penalty games, the developers note that sessions here are more ‘heartwarming’ in nature. Not a bad option for those looking to learn the ropes, or just chill with their favorite characters. Then there’s the Club Mode Extra: Paikuzushi Chapter, which is a newly added mode that features unlockable cutscenes after winning matches. That’s not all either, as there’s a Bonus Gallery where you can enjoy the new illustrations alongside character audio dramas. Related Higurashi creator is joining fans on a tour of the real village that inspired the game Rurouni Kenshin: Everything we know about the 2023 reboot Jujutsu Kaisen: Who is Hiromi Higuruma? Yuji’s ally explained Article continues after ad 1 of 4 Fortunately for those who don’t know how to play mahjong (couldn’t be me), you’ll be pleased to know that there’s an auto mode. By selecting this option, the computer will take control of your moves, so you’ll still be able to experience the story and character animations without having to pick up a beginner’s guide to mahjong. Article continues after ad Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster is currently set for a 2027 launch on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in Japan. There’s currently no word on an English release, but given that the original Higurashi and Umineko visual novels are available in the West, we’ll hopefully get our hands on the upcoming release too. Article continues after ad In other Higurashi-based news, the game’s creator will be joining fans on a tour of the real mountain village that inspired the game . After all, having Shinji screaming while killing Angels isn’t exactly the most relaxing way to start the day. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad Crunchyroll Japanese voice actors Kotono Mitsuishi and Yuriko Yamaguchi will both be reprising their roles as Misato and Ritsuko in the exclusive train drama, too. Listeners will also be eligible for an original acrylic keychain, featuring Shinji, Rei, Asuka, Kaworu, and Mari seated together inside a train carriage. There’s also a keychain styled after a Shinkansen information display up for grabs, for those who are both train and Eva fans. title: New anime goes viral for opening with a massive financial warning

details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 TV & Movies Anime New anime goes viral for opening with a massive financial warning by James Busby Published: Oct 02, 2026, 12:31 Save for later Save for later Crunchyroll Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News A new anime has released a lengthy warning about foreign exchange trading, urging fans to take extra care to avoid any financial risks that could “interfere with one’s daily life”. Warnings that flash up before you settle into a show or game aren’t exactly new, especially for media that involves unsettling themes or imagery. Back in 2025, Silent Hill f famously shocked fans with a warning so intense that it had fans questioning what kind of experience they were in for. Article continues after ad However, a new show about foreign exchange trading (FX Fighter Kurumi-chan) is going viral after its creators have urged viewers to take extra precautions if they decide to get into the high-risk world of buying and selling currencies. FX Fighter Kurumi-chan gives warning over loss of money For those who don’t know, FX Fighter Kurumi-chan follows college student Kurumi Fukuga as she enters the risky world of foreign exchange trading following the tragic death of her mother. Kurumi finds herself taking financial risks, all with the aim of earning back the 20 million yen her mother lost. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad It’s pretty riveting stuff, but as you can imagine, the anime isn’t exactly the kind of thing you put on to wind down with. However, due to the nature of the series, the creators prepared the following warning: “This is a work of fiction. Forex (foreign exchange margin trading) is a high-risk venture, and it’s possible for losses to exceed margin payments. There is a risk that excessive trading can interfere with one’s daily life, so please think it over carefully and proceed with caution. title: Heated anime body pillow lets fans feel their favorite character’s warmth
summary: A heated body pillow that recreates the warmth of a human body has been released, taking naps with your favorite anime waifus to new uncharted heights.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment Heated anime body pillow lets fans feel their favorite character’s warmth by James Busby Published: Sep 14, 2026, 11:52 Save for later Save for later Thanko Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News A heated body pillow that recreates the warmth of a human body has been released, taking naps with your favorite anime waifus and husbandos to new heights. Whether you’re snuggling with Silent Hill 2’s James Sunderland body pillow or receiving Attack on Titan’s Colossal Titan , there’s a chance you’ve felt the initial coolness of their touch. Fortunately, the minds over at Japanese electronics company Thanko have created a body pillow that’s as warm as a loving embrace. Article continues after ad Heated body pillow brings warmth to the coldest nights Creators Thanko asks the question that has undoubtedly been on your mind: “Have you ever returned home to a quiet night after an event and wished your favorite character was there beside you?” If you have found yourself pondering this age-old question, then the Oshi no Nukumori Body Pillow will put this thought to bed once and for all. According to the translated store page , the body pillow uses a built-in heater that comes with three different settings that go all the way up to 42°C. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad However, Thanko recommends setting the body pillow to cosy 36°C for that realistic human body temperature (there really is no way to write that without being creepy, is there?). With the medium setting toggled on, the creators say owners will get around seven hours of warmth. There’s also an automatic shutoff that powers the pillow down after four hours, just in case you forget to power it off. 1 of 3 The pillow also stands at 5 feet 3 inches long and measures 12.6 inches wide by 7.9 inches deep, and weighs around 4.6 pounds. This means it can be kitted out with most body pillow coverings, so your favorite anime and game characters should fit it nicely. title: Dragon Ball Goku voice actor furious at “unforgivable” AI videos using her voice: “It has no heart”
summary: Dragon Ball voice actress Masako Nozawa has slammed AI-generated videos using her voice without permission.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 TV & Movies Anime Dragon Ball Goku voice actor furious at “unforgivable” AI videos using her voice: “It has no heart” by Michael Gwilliam Published: Oct 15, 2026, 17:53 Save for later Save for later NHK/Toei Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News Dragon Ball voice actress Masako Nozawa has slammed AI-generated videos using her voice without permission, calling the practice “unforgivable” and comparing it to theft. The 89-year-old Japanese actress has voiced Goku since Dragon Ball debuted in 1986, also portraying characters including Gohan and Goten throughout the franchise. Her decades of work have earned her widespread recognition, with Nozawa becoming the first voice actor to receive one of Japan’s highest cultural honors in 2025. However, the Dragon Ball legend is now speaking out against the growing use of artificial intelligence to recreate her performances without consent. Article continues after ad Crunchyroll Goku voice actress blasts AI videos for stealing her voice Speaking to Japanese broadcaster NHK , Nozawa expressed her frustration with AI-generated videos that imitate her voice, arguing that the technology cannot replicate the emotion behind her performances. “It has no heart,” she said, according to a translation shared by Dragon Ball Hype. “It might even be a perfect copy. But it has no heart, does it? Without heart, it’s no good, whatever the role. Even a voice that’s only crying is different when you cry with real feeling. That’s what I believe.” Article continues after ad Article continues after ad “This is not my voice. Using it without permission is unforgivable. It’s the same as theft, and it makes me angry,” she added. Nozawa stressed that her voice and acting belong to her, arguing that anyone looking to recreate or use her performances should seek permission first. Masako Nozawa comments on the use of generative AI in voice acting: "I can't forgive using it without asking. I want people to follow the rules.” After watching AI videos of her voice: "This is not my voice. Using it without asking is unforgivable. It's the same as stealing,… pic.twitter.com/o3w5F1rBeK — Hype (@DbsHype) October 15, 2026 The comments came as the Japan Actors Union, which represents roughly 2,600 actors and voice performers, announced new guidelines on October 15 aimed at protecting performers from unauthorized AI voice cloning. Related Genshin Impact dev wins over $100K after AI company cloned character voices Evangelion star calls for Japanese government help over “heartbreaking” AI voice cloning Goku voice actor accuses popular Dragon Ball YouTuber of using AI to fake voices Article continues after ad The guidelines call for performers to give consent before their voices are used to train AI models, generate new recordings, or appear in published content. They also outline appropriate compensation and protections against unauthorized use. Nozawa is not entirely opposed to the technology, however. In a video message supporting the announcement, she expressed excitement about AI’s potential while criticizing those using performers’ voices without permission. She’s far from the only anime star raising concerns about the growing technology. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad In August 2026, Evangelion voice actress Megumi Ogata called AI voice cloning “heartbreaking” and urged Japan’s government to intervene. Meanwhile, Goku’s English voice actor Sean Schemmel previously accused a popular Dragon Ball YouTuber of using AI to imitate his voice , although the creator denied the allegations and insisted the impressions were entirely his own. With AI-generated anime content becoming increasingly widespread, Nozawa’s comments highlight the growing concerns among voice actors about losing control of the characters and performances they’ve spent decades bringing to life. summary: A man claims he survived a car accident by remembering a technique from Detective Conan, which showed him how to escape a sinking vehicle.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 TV & Movies Anime Man says he used technique from Detective Conan to save his life after car plunged into river by Michael Gwilliam Published: Nov 09, 2026, 16:56 Save for later Save for later X/nozinozi053/Crunchyroll Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News A man in Japan claims he survived a terrifying car accident by remembering a technique from the anime Detective Conan, which showed him how to escape a sinking vehicle. The driver, who posts on X as nozinozi053, revealed on November 8 that his car had ended up in a river following a collision with another motorist. According to his account, the other driver had been reversing near a cemetery when they suddenly pulled forward as he attempted to pass, resulting in a collision. Article continues after ad With his vehicle submerged, the man initially believed he was going to die. However, a scene from Detective Conan suddenly came to mind. “For the first 20 seconds or so, I really thought I was going to die,” he wrote. “But then this scene suddenly flashed through my mind, and I managed to escape alive.” “I can’t thank the creator of Conan enough!” これが、水没してる時に頭をよぎって、生きて脱出出来ました！コナンの作者には感謝しきれません！ ほんとに最初の20秒くらいで死を覚悟したが、不意にこのシーンが頭を過り、生きて出れました https://t.co/8vsQoZeBY6 pic.twitter.com/TLApBiOzIP — みらじーの (@nozinozi053) November 8, 2026 Detective Conan episode 1078 helped driver escape sinking car The scene comes from episode 1078, titled ‘The Black Organization’s Scheme (Landing),’ which originally aired on April 1, 2023. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad In the episode, FBI agent Andre Camel drives into the ocean while being pursued by the Black Organization. Trapped underwater, he discovers that his car doors won’t open because of the pressure outside. Conan instructs Camel to breathe from an air pocket near the roof until the vehicle fills with enough water for the pressure inside and outside to equalize, allowing him to open the door and escape. The sequence is detailed in the anime’s official episode synopsis . I realized it was the door, so I pushed it open with all my strength,” he explained. “It was a little heavy, but it opened relatively easily.” When asked whether the other driver had helped him, he revealed that he hadn’t even seen the person responsible for the collision. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad Police, emergency services, and local residents subsequently gathered at the scene. Although the man survived, his car was reportedly written off. In a follow-up post , he also revealed that his jacket had floated away in the river. title: Starbucks Japan unveils new Potato Soupuccino that’s said to be more than just soup
summary: New “self-care soup” blurs the line between soup and cappuccino. With temperatures starting to dip in Japan, Starbucks is adding warmth to its menu with an all-new Soupuccino. First introduced in 2025, the Soupuccino blurs the line between soup and cappuccino by adding a frothy, fluffy foam to the mix, creating a light and airy […]
details: New “self-care soup” blurs the line between soup and cappuccino. With temperatures starting to dip in Japan, Starbucks is adding warmth to its menu with an all-new Soupuccino . First introduced in 2025, the Soupuccino blurs the line between soup and cappuccino by adding a frothy, fluffy foam to the mix, creating a light and airy soup that looks great and is fun and easy to sip on. ▼ Now, after serving up the Soupuccino in truffle and pumpkin flavours, Starbucks is giving us an all-new flavour: Potato . This new ingredient is said to add extra heartiness to the Soupuccino, with milk providing a gentle creaminess for a delicious “ self-care soup ”. The concept of “self-care” is one that the chain is actively using to promote the Soupuccino, with Starbucks saying it offers an opportunity for you to take care of yourself even during a busy day . Whether it’s a morning cup on a chilly day, a light snack during a work break, or a moment to unwind in the evening, Starbucks is encouraging customers to wrap both hands around the warm cup and enjoy “a gentle flavour encased in fluffy foam”. The Potato Soupuccino is richly layered, replicating the fluffy, oven-baked texture and taste of potatoes as the main element. The first sip imparts the deep, savoury flavour of caramelised onions, followed by subtle hints of sweet vegetables. The gentle sweetness and buttery smoothness of potatoes brings everything together, creating a comforting flavour that’s perfect for the colder months. ▼ As you drink the soup, the flavours blend together, becoming even richer, while roasted almonds on top add crunch and a nutty accent. Each cup is finished by a barista who steams the milk individually, giving the soup a smooth layer of foam, similar to a cappuccino, for a distinctive drinking experience. Another appealing feature is the option to pay a little extra to switch the milk to suit your personal tastes – switching to almond milk, for instance, complements the fragrant roasted almonds, further enhancing the taste and texture of the potato. The Potato Soupuccino will be priced from 491 yen (US$3.11) for a Short and 530 yen for a Tall. According to Starbucks, the new release is more than just a soup – it’s a gesture of self-care that’s perfectly timed for the end of the year, when you may find yourself putting your own needs last as you get caught up in work, studies and household chores. The idea of taking a comforting break with a warm cup of soup in hand is one we can certainly get on board with, and we’ll definitely be trying it when it’s released for a limited time starting 13 November. title: Katsuya takes perhaps a little too much liberty with its take on a Niigata soul food
summary: We might be just a little bit saucy about this double-sauced version of a classic local specialty dish. Way back in 1931, a restaurant called Komatsu Parlor in Nagaoka, Niigata Prefecture served up a novel dish that was dubbed Western-style katsudon, in which tonkatsu (deep-fried pork cutlet) was placed on top of a bed of […]
details: We might be just a little bit saucy about this double-sauced version of a classic local specialty dish. Way back in 1931, a restaurant called Komatsu Parlor in Nagaoka, Niigata Prefecture served up a novel dish that was dubbed Western-style katsudon , in which tonkatsu (deep-fried pork cutlet) was placed on top of a bed of rice and topped with a thick, Western-style sauce, usually with either a ketchup or a demi-glace base. Not only was it tasty but it had an elegant, refined appearance, and it quickly became known as a popular “soul food” of the area. Fast forward to the present, and modern tonkatsu and katsudon chain Katsuya released a limited-time menu item on November 6 for Aigake Western-Style Katsu Rice (869 yen/US$5.48). This dish is said to take inspiration from Nagaoka’s specialty dish while putting its own unique Katsuya spin on it…perhaps a little too much of a spin, in fact. Nevertheless, devoted fans of Katsuya that we are , we wanted to check it out for ourselves and headed to our local branch. We were particularly curious about whether the sauce would be the ketchup type or demi-glace type. When our order arrived in front of us, we were a little bit shocked at the contents. ▼ It turns out that it had both. The deep-fried pork loin was cut into six chunks, half of which were covered in a Japanese “aurora sauce” concoction of ketchup and Kewpie mayo… …while the other half were drenched in a demi-glace sauce. In other words, it was a best-of-both-worlds kind of deal. Some skeptics may think it’s unnecessary to combine both types on a single plate, but at least this way we could sample two different versions of the same dish. The tonkatsu was resting on a small bed of white rice and on the side was also the typical accompaniment of shaved cabbage along with Japanese-style “Napolitan” ketchup spaghetti and a sunny-side-up fried egg. The plate as a whole looked a little bit busy, like a slightly chaotic fried food theme park. We started our meal with the demi-glace side of the plate. It was strange how the addition of a sauce like this could elevate the ordinary tonkatsu into a somehow gourmet flavor. On the other hand, while the aurora sauce on its own had a strong, sour kick–to the point where we tasted the same burst of acidity as with pickled ume–it evened out splendidly on top of the meat. This blended sauce might not be for everyone, but we actually preferred it to the demi-glace version. Moving on, the pasta was springer than we initially thought and had that classic Napolitan taste with bits of bacon. Its flavor was further enhanced by its the seeping egg yolk neighbor. There was also enough sauce beginning to pool on the plate that we were able to pour it over the cabbage and turn over a new leaf. All in all, while we enjoyed the new Aigake Western-Style Katsu Rice dish, we have to wonder if all of Katsuya’s extreme modifications to its originator in Niigata are completely necessary. The plate also lacked a little bit of the visual impact of other recent Katsuya creations that we’ve tried . In any case, we’ll continue searching for more local takes on the tasty, deep-fried dish that have been around for decades . title: Amazing Japanese yogurt spoon scoops up every last drop of dairy effortlessly
summary: While the rest of the world is scraping away at their yogurt containers, we’re keeping things cultured with our new favorite spoon. In today’s installment of Japanese kitchen gadgets that just make everything easier, we’d like to present a spoon–not just any spoon, but a magical spoon that specializes in scooping up every last bit […]
details: While the rest of the world is scraping away at their yogurt containers, we’re keeping things cultured with our new favorite spoon. In today’s installment of Japanese kitchen gadgets that just make everything easier , we’d like to present a spoon –not just any spoon, but a magical spoon that specializes in scooping up every last bit of your yogurt. OK, while we can’t guarantee that it’s actually imbued with magic, the spoon produced by Japanese houseware brand Marna sure seems to have some kind of mystical ability. We’d caught wind of it through the grapevine and decided to test it out for ourselves. Its simple design involves a pliable tip made of silicone and a sturdy blue handle. ▼ We’ve got a good gut feeling about this one. From a side view, it’s easy to see how the handle curves into an elegant angle at the tip. Let’s test it out in action. Would it really make a difference in how we eat yogurt now and forevermore? As we began eating, we noticed immediately how little effort it took to perfectly scour the inside of the container from all angles. It felt like a mini spatula in this sense, also being quieter than a regular metal spoon. Amazingly, there was almost no yogurt left clinging to the bottom or the sides of the cup once we had finished, despite not making any extra effort to scrape at the very end. We next decided to hold a mini controlled experiment by eating one more of the exact same kind of yogurt using a regular metal spoon to compare the results. We tried eating it as gracefully as possible but there was still some yogurt left at the bottom of the cup at the end. It seems that the fixed shape of the metal tip in this case prevented us from getting it all. In conclusion, the spoon served its purpose incredibly well, living up to its promise of not wasting any yogurt with minimal effort. ▼ Yogurt container after using a regular metal spoon (left) and the special yogurt spoon (right) In a fun collaboration, Marna also sells a version of the spoon together with Hiroshima-based company Chichiyasu , the first company in Japan to begin selling yogurt in 1917. Marna’s yogurt spoon retails for 594 yen (US$3.75) and can be ordered through Marna’s official site or Rakuten Japan . While we never knew what we had been missing all of these years, it’s going to be hard to go back to eating yogurt any other way now. title: Pokémon card game’s expansion features art from Fist of the North Star creator
summary: Tetsuo Hara shows he can draw for both blood-soaked martial arts action and Pokémon. The Pokémon Trading Card Game pumps out way too many cards for one single illustrator to handle all of them, and being approached by the Pokémon Company to draw one can be a major feather in the cap of upcoming artists […]
details: Tetsuo Hara shows he can draw for both blood-soaked martial arts action and Pokémon . The Pokémon Trading Card Game pumps out way too many cards for one single illustrator to handle all of them, and being approached by the Pokémon Company to draw one can be a major feather in the cap of upcoming artists with a talent for drawing cute and cuddly critters…but it turns out it can also be an appealing project for legendary veterans of drawing ultra-violent, extra-macho manga series too. The game’s new Hado Seeker/Aura Seeker expansion packs (pictured above) are set to go on sale soon in Japan, and among the cards that could be waiting inside packs is one featuring Crasher Wake , the Pastoria City Gym Leader who first appeared in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl. The SAR (“special art rare”) version of the Crasher’s Passion card shows off an especially high level of detail on the character’s muscles, which makes sense once you know that it was drawn by none other than Tetsuo Hara, creator and artist of Fist of the North Star! Hara, who began drawing his post-apocalyptic marital arts saga in 1983, brings his distinct aesthetic of heavy shadowing to convey the mass of characters’ muscles, plus a whole lot of fist-shaped after images to represent rapid punch flurries, to the artwork. “Crasher is a pro wrestler, so I thought a lot about how best to show his toughness and physique,” the artist says. “I always want to pursue a sense of realism in my artwork, so I have to take into consideration how stylized I can get. At first, I was planning to draw Crashed with even bigger muscles, but after considering how that would or wouldn’t align with fans’ perception of the character, I ended up toning it down.” For the illustration’s layout, Hara says he wanted Crasher to be up in a wrestling ring, in order to create a powerful presence, but drawing him from that angle ran the risk of making his face look tiny, so he decided to have the character angled to be looking down from on high. This also allowed him to add in a few of the ring’s overhead lights in a stealthy homage to the constellation-motif that appears in Fist of the North Star . Hara also says that once he started adding after-images of Crasher’s punches, he realized the composition needed more and more, so many that he found himself thinking “Maybe I shouldn’t have done this” because of all the extra work he’d created for himself, but in the end it seems like a pretty safe bet that most fans are going to be very satisfied with how things turned out. For those wanting a closer look, the original artwork for the card will be on display at the Pokémon Card Station specialty shop attached to the Pokémon Center Ikebukuro store in Tokyo from November 30 to January 11 . This actually isn’t Hara’s first time to lend his talents to the Pokémon Trading Card Game . In 2024, he drew artwork for a special Palafin card that was part of the Terastal Fest Ex, which also featured an homage to Fist of the North Star protagonist Kenshiro’s iconic Hundred Crack Fist attack. Hara says that there’s a unique challenge in balancing his personal artistic sensibilities with the atmosphere of the Pokémon world, but that he’s enjoyed finding a way to blend the two, and the experience he acquired working on the Palafin card made the process of creating the Crasher one smoother, so hopefully there’ll be more Pokémon projects for him in the future. For the time being, though, the Hado Seeker expansion packs are scheduled to go on sale in Japan on November 27 . title: Forza Horizon 6 pone en la mira a las waifus: hasta unos ojos entrecerrados pueden ser un problema
summary: Forza Horizon 6 genera polémica por eliminar diseños de anime y sancionar a cientos de jugadores, incluso por pinturas privadas con personajes sugerentes.
details: Cultura Otaku Forza Horizon 6 pone en la mira a las waifus: hasta unos ojos entrecerrados pueden ser un problema El juego está sancionando diseños de anime, incluso privados, y ya son cientos los usuarios afectados. Ryo hace 1 hora 2 Comentarios ADS Resulta bastante irónico que un videojuego de carreras ambientado en Japón termine teniendo problemas con una de las costumbres más reconocibles de su cultura automovilística. Los creadores de Forza Horizon 6 están eliminando diseños de vehículos decorados con personajes de anime y sancionando a sus autores por considerarlos demasiado sugerentes. Lo más curioso es que, según las explicaciones de los responsables, unos ojos entrecerrados, labios ligeramente abiertos o determinada ropa pueden influir en la decisión de censurar una ilustración . La controversia comenzó a tomar fuerza durante septiembre, cuando varios jugadores japoneses denunciaron que sus creaciones habían desaparecido del videojuego. Se trataba principalmente de los llamados itasha , automóviles personalizados con ilustraciones de personajes de anime, manga y videojuegos, una práctica que tiene bastante popularidad en Japón y que lleva años formando parte de la comunidad de Forza . Ante las quejas, Playground Games publicó el pasado 30 de octubre un comunicado en sus redes sociales chinas para explicar los criterios de moderación. Según la compañía, los diseños con expresiones faciales sexualmente sugerentes, ropa provocativa o poses que destaquen determinadas partes del cuerpo pueden considerarse inapropiados, aunque no muestren desnudos. Eso sí, el estudio aclaró que no se trata de prohibir automáticamente cualquier personaje atractivo o con poca ropa. Por ejemplo, una ilustración de alguien usando bikini en la playa podría ser aceptable si el contexto, la postura y la composición no buscan transmitir una intención sexual. El problema, según los responsables, está en la combinación de elementos y no necesariamente en uno solo. Ni siquiera los diseños privados están completamente a salvo Otra de las cosas que más sorprendió a los jugadores fue descubrir que las reglas también se aplican a diseños que nunca fueron compartidos públicamente . La compañía explicó que, aunque una pintura permanezca sin publicar, otros usuarios podrían verla si el creador la utiliza en su automóvil durante una partida. Por esa razón, todos los diseños deben respetar las clasificaciones por edades del videojuego. Mientras que en Japón Forza Horizon 6 está clasificado para mayores de 12 años, en otras regiones tiene categorías que permiten jugar a públicos más jóvenes. El estudio sostiene que las creaciones de los usuarios deben cumplir con los criterios apropiados para esas audiencias. En cuanto al alcance de las sanciones, la compañía compartió algunas cifras para defender su sistema de moderación. Durante el último mes se habían creado más de 12.5 millones de contenidos personalizados y recibido aproximadamente 21,900 denuncias. De ellas, solamente el 3 por ciento terminaron en medidas disciplinarias que afectaron a menos de 700 usuarios . La mayoría recibió advertencias o suspensiones temporales, mientras que alrededor de 50 cuentas fueron suspendidas permanentemente por diseños que, según el estudio, contenían desnudos explícitos. Los responsables también aseguraron que cada denuncia es examinada por moderadores humanos y que recibir muchas quejas sobre una misma creación no hace que esta sea castigada automáticamente. Los jugadores japoneses no quedaron convencidos Sin embargo, estas explicaciones no lograron terminar con las críticas. Varios creadores consideran que las reglas sobre expresiones sugerentes son demasiado ambiguas y temen perder sus trabajos por ilustraciones que no consideran inapropiadas. También se han reportado eliminaciones de diseños que ni siquiera incluían personajes de anime, sino únicamente logotipos relacionados con automóviles. Otro detalle que causó molestia fue que la explicación más específica se publicara inicialmente para la comunidad china, semanas después de que comenzaran las denuncias en Japón. Para empeorar las cosas, el comunicado del 30 de octubre desapareció poco después de su publicación , aunque su contenido ya había sido traducido y compartido entre los jugadores. Por ahora, Playground Games mantiene que las ilustraciones de anime no están prohibidas por sí mismas, pero que deben cumplir con las normas de contenido del videojuego. Mientras tanto, los aficionados a los itasha siguen cuestionando dónde está exactamente la línea entre un diseño perfectamente aceptable y uno que podría costarles su cuenta. ¿Crees que unos ojos entrecerrados y labios ligeramente abiertos son suficientes para considerar provocativa a una waifu, o Forza Horizon 6 está llevando demasiado lejos sus reglas de moderación? title: YouTube banea a una seiyuu por Azur Lane, ¡el videojuego donde ella misma trabaja!
summary: YouTube eliminó el canal de Hinata Yuka, actriz de voz de Azur Lane, con 250,000 suscriptores. La seiyuu denunció un posible error de moderación.
details: Cultura Otaku YouTube banea a una seiyuu por Azur Lane, ¡el videojuego donde ella misma trabaja! Hinata Yuka perdió un canal con 250,000 suscriptores y más de 20 millones de vistas tras mostrar contenido del juego. Aiko hace 1 hora 1 Comentarios ADS Imagínate trabajar como actriz de voz en un videojuego, transmitirlo para tus seguidores y terminar perdiendo tu canal de YouTube por mostrar sus personajes. Pues algo así le ocurrió a Hinata Yuka , una seiyuu japonesa (famosa por prestar su voz para series de anime para adultos como Kaede to Suzu y también a juegos eroge) que anunció que la plataforma eliminó su canal de aproximadamente 250,000 suscriptores por supuestas infracciones relacionadas con contenido sexual. Lo curioso es que la artista atribuye el problema a sus transmisiones de Azur Lane , un videojuego donde ella misma interpreta a uno de los personajes. La situación comenzó a complicarse durante septiembre, cuando Hinata realizó una transmisión dedicada a los nuevos atuendos de Azur Lane . La actriz presta su voz a Golden Hind y decidió mostrar uno de los vestuarios recientemente incorporados para su personaje. Sin embargo, el archivo de aquella transmisión terminó siendo eliminado por YouTube y, posteriormente, también desaparecieron algunos fragmentos que había publicado. El pasado 25 de octubre, la actriz reveló que había recibido una nueva restricción que le impedía publicar contenido durante dos semanas. En ese momento todavía podía bromear sobre la situación, pues su canal seguía funcionando. Pero apenas tres días después, el 28 de octubre, recibió una noticia mucho peor: YouTube había eliminado completamente su cuenta . De acuerdo con las capturas compartidas por la propia artista, la plataforma justificó la medida por supuestas violaciones de sus políticas sobre desnudez y contenido sexual. Sin embargo, Hinata considera que se trata de un error del sistema de moderación automática , pues las imágenes cuestionadas pertenecían al propio videojuego y mostraban vestuarios disponibles oficialmente para los jugadores. La seiyuu presentó una apelación, pero fue rechazada. Posteriormente, contactó públicamente a la cuenta de asistencia de YouTube para solicitar que un empleado revisara manualmente su caso , argumentando que la inteligencia artificial había confundido las ilustraciones de Azur Lane con contenido prohibido. El 30 de octubre informó que había recibido otra respuesta indicando que recuperar su canal sería difícil. Y no estamos hablando precisamente de una cuenta pequeña. Según las estadísticas recopiladas por Yutura, el canal había sido creado en mayo de 2018 y acumulaba más de 20.6 millones de reproducciones y 369 videos . Además de sus transmisiones de videojuegos, Hinata publicaba contenido ASMR, interpretaciones de voz y canciones originales, por lo que el cierre también significó perder años de trabajo y recuerdos compartidos con sus seguidores. Aunque la situación la dejó bastante desanimada, la actriz aseguró que no se arrepiente de haber transmitido Azur Lane ni de los demás contenidos que decidió compartir. Por ahora, planea continuar sus actividades mediante las plataformas japonesas Ci-en y Niconico, mientras mantiene la esperanza de recuperar algún día su espacio en YouTube. Cabe aclarar que, aunque Hinata atribuye el cierre a un error de moderación relacionado con el videojuego, YouTube no ha confirmado públicamente que una inteligencia artificial haya provocado la sanción . Tampoco se ha detallado cuáles fueron todas las publicaciones consideradas infractoras. ¿Crees que YouTube debería revisar manualmente estos casos antes de eliminar canales con años de actividad, especialmente cuando las imágenes cuestionadas pertenecen a un videojuego que se distribuye oficialmente? title: Las Vtubers de Yugiri High School cancelan su primer gran festival y crece la polémica contra viviON
summary: Yugiri High School canceló su primer gran festival tras la suspensión indefinida de Amarasu Terasu, mientras crecen las críticas contra viviON.
details: Cultura Otaku Las Vtubers de Yugiri High School cancelan su primer gran festival y crece la polémica contra viviON La suspensión de Amarasu Terasu provocó la cancelación del evento apenas dos días antes de su inicio. Mirukaru hace 31 segundos 0 Comentarios ADS Los fanáticos de Yugiri High School estaban a punto de disfrutar del primer gran festival de sus VTubers favoritas, pero los planes terminaron derrumbándose apenas dos días antes del evento. La compañía viviON anunció la cancelación del festival virtual del grupo después de suspender indefinidamente las actividades de Amarasu Terasu, una de sus cinco integrantes. Y para complicar todavía más las cosas, la decisión llegó poco después de que las propias chicas hablaran públicamente sobre los problemas que habían enfrentado con su administración. El festival estaba programado para celebrarse del 31 de octubre al 2 de noviembre de 2026 a través del canal oficial de YouTube. Se trataba de la primera gran actividad conjunta desde la apertura de dicho canal, con presentaciones musicales, videos especiales y diferentes actividades preparadas por las cinco integrantes. Sin embargo, el 28 de octubre, viviON anunció que Amarasu Terasu quedaría suspendida por tiempo indefinido mientras la empresa investigaba diversas declaraciones y comportamientos registrados durante sus transmisiones. La compañía explicó que necesitaba verificar los hechos y que no podía ofrecer detalles adicionales debido a cuestiones contractuales. Como parte de las medidas, la agencia también ocultó el archivo de una transmisión realizada ese mismo día y solicitó que los usuarios evitaran compartir fragmentos de su contenido. Hasta el momento, no se ha especificado públicamente qué declaraciones concretas motivaron la suspensión ni cuándo podría regresar la VTuber. Lo que más llamó la atención de los seguidores fue que, apenas unos días antes, las cinco integrantes habían hablado sobre las dificultades que enfrentaron durante los preparativos de su debut . El 24 de octubre participaron en una transmisión donde cuestionaron la falta de apoyo y organización que, según sus relatos, experimentaron durante la gestión de su anterior productor. Entre las situaciones mencionadas se encontraban proyectos que no avanzaban como esperaban, problemas para organizar actividades conjuntas y la sensación de tener que resolver por su cuenta diferentes aspectos de su trabajo. También reconocieron que algunas condiciones habían comenzado a mejorar con los cambios administrativos. Por esa razón, la suspensión de Amarasu provocó nuevas críticas contra viviON. Algunos seguidores sospecharon que la decisión podría estar relacionada con las declaraciones sobre los problemas internos de la compañía. Sin embargo, esa relación no ha sido confirmada , y la empresa tampoco ha identificado públicamente cuáles fueron los comentarios que considera problemáticos. El 29 de octubre llegó el segundo golpe. La administración explicó que el festival había sido preparado específicamente para contar con las cinco integrantes y que, ante la ausencia de Amarasu, no podrían ofrecer el evento en las condiciones prometidas. Por ello, decidieron cancelarlo por completo y ofrecieron disculpas a quienes esperaban las actividades. La controversia resulta todavía más delicada porque Yugiri High School es un grupo hermano de Aogiri High School , otra agrupación de VTubers administrada por la misma compañía que recientemente también enfrentó problemas de organización. En septiembre, un concierto de aniversario de Chiyoura Chomi tuvo que posponerse apenas dos días antes de su celebración. Posteriormente, la empresa reconoció distintas fallas administrativas y anunció una reorganización interna. Como parte de ese proceso, también canceló un festival musical de Aogiri High School previsto para diciembre . Así, dos agrupaciones de la misma compañía terminaron perdiendo importantes eventos en cuestión de semanas. Mientras viviON asegura que trabaja para mejorar las condiciones de sus talentos, los seguidores de Yugiri High School continúan esperando una explicación más clara sobre el futuro de Amarasu Terasu y las actividades del grupo. ¿Crees que viviON hizo bien en cancelar el festival para no presentarlo sin una de sus integrantes, o debería haber encontrado una manera de realizarlo con las otras cuatro VTubers? title: La seiyuu Hazuki Tanda se disfrazó de Shaun the Sheep y terminó acusada de racismo
summary: La seiyuu Hazuki Tanda recibió acusaciones de racismo por su disfraz de Shaun the Sheep. Su maquillaje de Halloween dividió a los usuarios de redes sociales.
details: Cultura Otaku La seiyuu Hazuki Tanda se disfrazó de Shaun the Sheep y terminó acusada de racismo La seiyuu de D4DJ se pintó el rostro de negro para Halloween y provocó una discusión internacional. Kenji hace 33 minutos 0 Comentarios ADS Uno pensaría que disfrazarse de una oveja para Halloween sería una de las decisiones menos problemáticas del mundo, pero parece que internet siempre encuentra una manera de sorprendernos. La actriz de voz japonesa Hazuki Tanda , conocida por su participación en BanG Dream! y D4DJ , terminó envuelta en una controversia internacional después de publicar fotografías de su disfraz de Shaun the Sheep . ¿El problema? Se pintó el rostro de negro para recrear al personaje , algo que varios usuarios extranjeros interpretaron como una representación racista. Todo comenzó el pasado 31 de octubre, cuando la seiyuu compartió en X varias fotografías acompañadas de un sencillo saludo de Halloween. Para recrear a Shaun, el protagonista de la popular serie británica de animación, utilizó un traje cubierto de material blanco que simulaba lana, ropa negra y maquillaje oscuro en el rostro, dejando el contorno de los ojos de color blanco. Además, posó sosteniendo un plátano y algunas verduras , incluyendo un puerro. La publicación también incluía una imagen del personaje original para dejar claro cuál era la inspiración de su disfraz. Inicialmente, muchos seguidores japoneses celebraron la creatividad de la actriz y lo divertido que resultaba verla convertida en la famosa oveja. Sin embargo, cuando las fotografías comenzaron a circular fuera de Japón, las reacciones cambiaron. Varios usuarios acusaron a Tanda de recurrir al blackface , una práctica históricamente asociada con representaciones racistas de personas negras. Las críticas se intensificaron por la presencia del plátano, debido a que esta fruta también ha sido utilizada en insultos y estereotipos raciales. La controversia provocó una discusión entre usuarios de diferentes países. Mientras algunos consideraban que pintarse el rostro de negro era inapropiado independientemente del personaje representado, otros recordaron un detalle bastante evidente: Shaun es una oveja que tiene la cara y las patas negras . Desde esa perspectiva, la actriz simplemente estaba intentando reproducir su apariencia original. Numerosos usuarios japoneses defendieron a Tanda y cuestionaron que el maquillaje pudiera interpretarse automáticamente como una burla racial. También hubo comentarios de seguidores internacionales que consideraban injustas las acusaciones, especialmente porque las fotografías mostraban claramente al personaje que estaba recreando. La discusión, sin embargo, tiene un trasfondo histórico. El blackface se popularizó durante el siglo XIX en espectáculos estadounidenses donde artistas blancos se maquillaban para caricaturizar a las personas negras, reforzando estereotipos discriminatorios. Por eso, algunos usuarios consideraron ofensiva la combinación de maquillaje oscuro, material parecido al algodón y un plátano, aunque esos elementos tuvieran otra explicación dentro del disfraz. La controversia llegó incluso a la prensa japonesa. En una entrevista publicada por NEWS Post Seven , la profesora Fumiko Sakashita, especialista en historia y cultura afroestadounidense de la Universidad Sofía, explicó que el caso de Tanda no necesariamente merece las mismas críticas , puesto que estaba representando a una oveja de rostro negro. No obstante, también consideró importante reflexionar sobre cuándo es realmente necesario modificar el color de la piel para interpretar a un personaje. Por ahora, Hazuki Tanda no ha publicado una explicación formal sobre las acusaciones , y su mensaje original de Halloween no hacía ninguna referencia a cuestiones raciales. Lo que comenzó como una publicación para mostrar un disfraz terminó convirtiéndose en una discusión sobre las diferencias culturales y la manera en que una misma imagen puede interpretarse de formas muy distintas. ¿Crees que el contexto de estar disfrazada de Shaun the Sheep debería ser suficiente para descartar las acusaciones, o consideras que Tanda pudo haber recreado al personaje de otra manera? title: One Piece brings back rare $400 East Blue and Nami Log Pose watches
summary: One Piece is bringing back two limited-edition watches that sold out when they launched in 2018, including one that recreates Nami’s iconic Log Pose.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment One Piece brings back rare $400 East Blue and Nami Log Pose watches by James Busby Published: Sep 15, 2026, 09:57 Save for later Save for later Tendence Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News One Piece is bringing back two limited-edition watches that sold out when they launched in 2018, including one that recreates Nami’s iconic Log Pose. Following hot on the heels of One Piece’s Timberland and Nike collab , the popular anime is now teaming up with Swiss watch brand Tendence. Headlining the re-release are two watches inspired by Nami’s Log Pose compass and an East Blue Model that is inspired by Luffy’s grand adventure across the sea. Article continues after ad However, only 500 watches are being made, so fans will need to act fast if they wish to add the limited-edition timepieces to their collections. One Piece gets limited-edition watch rerun First up is the Log Pose model, which recreates the navigational device Nami uses to chart a course through the Grand Line. According to the translated store page, the watch features a compass dial that rotates with the wearer’s wrist and sways as if responding to a magnetic field. Article continues after ad The clock face also features the Straw Hats’ signature Jolly Roger and giant rose-gold numbers, while the silicone straps come in soft beige. Article continues after ad 1 of 4 Its East Blue counterpart takes a grander approach to One Piece’s seafaring world, placing a map beneath Luffy’s pirate ship’s wheel. Just like the compass on Nami’s Log Pose watch, the ship wheel also moves with the wearer’s wrist. The site also mentions that the red-colored section of the wheel can be used to predict the wearer’s lucky direction for the day. If you follow it, maybe you’ll find your own Devil Fruit/One Piece, or just get hopelessly lost (who really knows?) title: Chainsaw Man turns Pochita into a life-size interactive sidekick
summary: Chainsaw Man fans will soon be able to bring Pochita home with a life-size doll that barks, growls, and even makes chainsaw noises.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment Chainsaw Man turns Pochita into a life-size interactive sidekick by James Busby Published: Sep 10, 2026, 09:58 Save for later Save for later MegaHouse Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News Chainsaw Man fans will soon be able to bring Pochita home with a life-size doll that barks, growls, and even makes chainsaw noises. Not to be outdone by the slew of giant Umamusume horse girls , hyper-realistic anime girl statues , and life-size Lilligant plushies , Chainsaw Man has also entered the world of hyper-realistic merch (and no, it’s not Reze!) Instead, anime fans in Japan will be able to purchase a realistic replica of Denji’s beloved devil doggo and resident good boy, Pochita. The little orange guy comes with articulated joints so that he can be posed, while owners can activate different sound effects that are sure to drive your IRL pets up the wall. Article continues after ad Pochita gets life-size collectible doll Pochita measures approximately 23.6 inches long, making him roughly the same length as a medium-sized dog. He’s pretty sizeable and will certainly get some looks from any guests or resident pets that you have in your home. Article continues after ad Besides his poseable legs, Pochita owners can also pull the character’s tail to mirror the cord Denji uses to activate his chainsaw powers in the anime. However, the doll’s biggest feature is its built-in sound unit. Article continues after ad When you stroke Pochita’s back, the dainty devil dog will make barking, growling, or revving engine noises. MegaHouse has also recreated smaller details from the anime, including Pochita’s rounded mouth and mini chainsaw blade. 1 of 3 According to the translated store page , Pochita’s glossy eyes have been designed to reflect the face of whoever is looking at it (cute!). Unfortunately, no international release has been revealed, but pre-orders are currently live in Japan. title: Clannad and Angel Beats creator opts against active cancer treatment to focus on work
summary: The writer and composer behind Clannad, Angel Beats, and Heaven Burns Red has been diagnosed with throat cancer and has chosen to focus on palliative care so he can continue creating.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment Anime Clannad and Angel Beats creator opts against active cancer treatment to focus on work by James Busby Published: Oct 19, 2026, 12:59 Save for later Save for later VisualArts/Key Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News The creator behind Clannad and the anime series Angel Beats has been diagnosed with throat cancer and has chosen to focus on palliative care so he can continue creating. On October 19, Visual Arts, the company Maeda works for, confirmed that he is currently hospitalized after being diagnosed with throat cancer. After considering his condition and the outlook for treatment, Maeda has decided against active treatment to conserve his strength for his creative work. The company also shared an update on his contributions to Heaven Burns Red and a new music project, which he now hopes to complete more quickly following his diagnosis. Article continues after ad Clannad writer shares health update and plans for future projects In its official statement, Visual Arts said Maeda began experiencing throat discomfort in early spring. However, a subsequent medical examination found that the swelling and pain became more pronounced over the summer. “After careful consideration of his condition and the outlook for treatment, Maeda has chosen not to pursue active treatment and instead to focus on palliative care, wishing to conserve his strength and devote himself to his creative work,” the company said. Article continues after ad Maeda has already completed his assigned writing for Heaven Burns Red’s main story through the first half of Chapter 6. He has also finished all the major story elements that will carry the narrative through the chapter’s conclusion, along with the lyrics and composition for songs featured in its first half. Article continues after ad However, Visual Arts said the progression of his illness could prevent him from participating in the creation of other scenarios and songs. Amazon Maeda also worked on Angel Beats as a planner and writer, and composed the anime’s music. Alongside his work on the game, Maeda had been developing an original music project with plans to release new songs on YouTube over the long term. His diagnosis has prompted him to change that approach. “He felt that there was little time remaining in which he would be able to continue creating,” the statement said. At his request, the finished works will be released on YouTube. Article continues after ad “Maeda is currently hospitalized, but even under these circumstances, he remains strongly determined to devote himself to creative work through to the very end,” the company said. “We would be grateful for your warm understanding and support of his wishes.” Fans wishing to send messages of encouragement can do so by using the email address at the bottom of the English statement . Visual Arts has also provided a postal address for letters, but has asked fans to refrain from sending gifts. The details can also be found via the statement linked above. title: Student sparks police investigation after bringing ‘Death Note’ book to school
summary: A Massachusetts student’s ‘Death Note’ notebook prompted a suspension and a real police investigation, with one parent demanding stronger action.
details: Trending Modern Warfare 4 Twitch EA FC 27 Wardogs GTA 6 Entertainment Student sparks police investigation after bringing ‘Death Note’ book to school by Michael Gwilliam Published: Oct 12, 2026, 14:51 Save for later Save for later Netflix Add as a preferred source on Google Follow on Google News A Massachusetts student’s ‘Death Note’ notebook prompted a suspension and a real police investigation, with one parent demanding stronger action despite officials finding no immediate threat. In Death Note , Light Yagami’s notebook attracts the attention of a mysterious detective known as L. At Chocksett Middle School in Sterling, a student’s version brought in local police. Administrators contacted officers on September 30 after discovering the notebook. Students had already been dismissed when police responded. Article continues after ad The student explained to staff it was connected to the manga and anime, in which Light uses a supernatural notebook to kill criminals by writing their names inside. Student suspended after Death Note concerns According to Boston.com , principal Tina Boss said investigators interviewed dozens of students and found no evidence the notebook was intended to threaten the school or any particular student. “Based on the information gathered, including dozens of student interviews and the investigation conducted by the Sterling Police Department, our multidisciplinary team has found no indication that the notebook or its contents were intended as a threat toward the school or any particular student,” she told the community. Article continues after ad Article continues after ad “The information indicates that the notebook was indeed connected to a television series and an inappropriate theme that has made its way into the school,” she added, further saying the book was from an anime with an “inappropriate theme.” Madhouse Police found no immediate threat and said they were not seeking criminal charges based on the available information. However, the explanation that it was inspired by Light’s fictional notebook did little to reassure parent Jen DiCandia. She said her daughter’s name appeared inside and challenged the student’s return following a three-day suspension. Related Teachers panic after finding student’s ‘Death Note’ at LeBron James’ I Promise school School suspends autistic 6-year-old for biting sandwich into shape of gun Rapper Fetty Wap sends flowers to principal suspended after his lyrics appeared in yearbook Article continues after ad “She deserves to feel safe in her classroom, every single day,” DiCandia wrote. The family has since retained an attorney, Sentinel & Enterprise reported . DiCandia said the students still shared three classes and called for them to be permanently separated at school. “My goal is for my daughter to attend school safely and continue her education without fear,” she said. “I don’t really care if it’s a joke, a video game, whatever. It’s not funny.” Article continues after ad Article continues after ad Death Note notebooks have a long history of causing trouble at school Ryuk’s notebook has inspired plenty of real-world imitations, and Sterling is far from the first school to investigate one. In September 2026, a 12-year-old in Florida was arrested after a ‘Death Note’ listing students and staff was found at Argyle Elementary School . Deputies said another student alerted a teacher after seeing the note being written. The teacher retrieved it from a trash can, and investigators arrested the student on a written-threat charge. Netflix In 2024, teachers and staff at LeBron James’ I Promise school in Akron, Ohio were left panicking after an instructor found a homemade ‘Death Note’ on the floor of a classroom Article continues after ad Back in 2008, two 12-year-olds in Alabama were arrested after authorities discovered a Death Note-inspired notebook containing students’ and school employees’ names. The boys reportedly told their principal it was a joke. In 2015, a Death Note-inspired list at a New Hampshire high school contained 17 names, alarming parents and prompting a school investigation. The notebooks lack the anime’s supernatural powers, but writing classmates’ names inside has repeatedly brought real consequences.
